newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daegu Merchant sets bonus, rights issues.
newsitem.headline: Daegu Merchant sets bonus, rights issues.

text.p: South Korea's Daegu Merchant Bank said on Friday it planned to offer a 2-for-5 rights issue and a 18-for-100 bonus issue in February as part of a plan to raise its paid-in capital to 30 billion won.
The company's paid-in capital is currently 17 billion won.

A Daegu statement said it planned a rights issue of 1.7 million shares, of which 20 percent would be offered to its employees. The rest will be allocated to shareholders registered as of January 13 for rights.
The rights issue price will be set at a 15 percent discount to the base price, which will be decided later.
Subscription is scheduled for February 12 and 13, with payment due by February 26.
Daegu also plans a bonus issue of 900,000 common shares for distribution to shareholders on February 27, it said. The face value of each share will be 5,000 won.
Daegu's shares rose 1,600 won to 22,100 won in mid-afternoon trading on Friday.
